title: No MineStrator Ads
description: Blocks ads from free MineStrator servers
body:
# No MineStrator Ads *Blocks ads from free MineStrator servers* Blocks tellraw commands that contain `MineStrator`, `FlexCore™`, `MyBoxFree`, `SmartBackup™`, and `MineStrator.com`
## How to use Simply add this mod to your game's `mods` folder.
